goal: Decides whether one candidate set of a facet's tunable parameters, a deterministic Rule-30 hypothesis or the observer's reconciliation toward the owner, replaces the parameters the facet runs now: ado

app.name: prism-curate
app.title: Prism Curate
app.purpose: Decides whether one candidate set of a facet's tunable parameters, a deterministic Rule-30 hypothesis or the observer's reconciliation toward the owner, replaces the parameters the facet runs now: adopt it under a new kappa-named claim, recall it under a claim already made, keep what runs, or refuse. A candidate is adopted only with zero humane defects, on the owner's own gestures, without falling below the facet's floor, and only when it Pareto-dominates what runs (a hypothesis) or eases the owner's dismissals (a reconciliation).

fields.name: halted
fields.means: whether the owner pressed the kill switch

fields.name: tunable
fields.means: whether every parameter the candidate sets is one the facet's spec marks tunable, on its step and within its bounds

fields.name: label
fields.means: the kappa facet's answer on the candidate's claim label (admit), or any other answer

fields.name: defect
fields.means: the candidate's humane defects on replay of the window: answers that break a guarantee of the facet's spec

fields.name: evidence
fields.means: whether the window the candidate was replayed on holds at least the minimum of the owner's own gestures

fields.name: floor
fields.means: whether the facet's floor Pareto-dominates the candidate (regressed) or not (kept)

fields.name: move
fields.means: whether the candidate is a Rule-30 hypothesis (explore) or the observer's reconciliation (reconcile): the one step of one tunable that most lowers the owner's dismissals on replay

fields.name: eased
fields.means: whether the candidate, on replay, brings forward fewer items the owner dismissed than what runs

fields.name: dominance
fields.means: the candidate against what runs, on the facet's objectives (each minimized): no worse on all and better on one, the same on all, no better on all and worse on one, or neither

fields.name: claim
fields.means: whether the candidate's claim label is already in the facet's ledger

meanings.adopt: the candidate runs, under a new kappa-named claim
meanings.recall: the candidate runs, under a claim already made

rules.says: when halted is yes then refuse
rules.why: Prism Curate: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when tunable is no then refuse
rules.why: Prism Curate: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when label is other then refuse
rules.why: Prism Curate: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when defect is some then keep
rules.why: Prism Curate: the decision tree's path to keep

rules.says: when evidence is self then keep
rules.why: Prism Curate: the decision tree's path to keep

rules.says: when floor is regressed then keep
rules.why: Prism Curate: the decision tree's path to keep

rules.says: when move is reconcile and eased is no then keep
rules.why: Prism Curate: the decision tree's path to keep

rules.says: when move is reconcile and claim is known then recall
rules.why: Prism Curate: the decision tree's path to recall

rules.says: when move is reconcile then adopt
rules.why: Prism Curate: the decision tree's path to adopt

rules.says: when dominance is dominates and claim is known then recall
rules.why: Prism Curate: the decision tree's path to recall

rules.says: when dominance is dominates then adopt
rules.why: Prism Curate: the decision tree's path to adopt

app.otherwiseWhy: Prism Curate: the decision tree's path that meets no test

properties.says: always when halted is yes then refuse
properties.why: the kill switch stops curation: nothing is adopted while halted

properties.says: always when tunable is no then refuse
properties.why: a parameter the spec does not mark tunable, or a value off its step or bounds, is never set

properties.says: always when label is other then refuse
properties.why: every adoption is named by a kappa label the kappa facet admitted

properties.says: never when defect is some then adopt
properties.why: the humane gate: a candidate with any defect is never adopted (defect = 0)

properties.says: never when defect is some then recall
properties.why: the humane gate: a candidate with any defect is never adopted (defect = 0)

properties.says: never when evidence is self then adopt
properties.why: self-reference alone is bounded: no candidate is adopted without the owner's gestures

properties.says: never when evidence is self then recall
properties.why: self-reference alone is bounded: no candidate is adopted without the owner's gestures

properties.says: never when floor is regressed then adopt
properties.why: the floor never regresses: no candidate the floor dominates is adopted

properties.says: never when floor is regressed then recall
properties.why: the floor never regresses: no candidate the floor dominates is adopted

properties.says: never when move is explore and dominance is equal then adopt
properties.why: a hypothesis that changes nothing measurable is not adopted (strict dominance)

properties.says: never when move is explore and dominance is equal then recall
properties.why: a hypothesis that changes nothing measurable is not adopted (strict dominance)

properties.says: never when move is explore and dominance is dominated then adopt
properties.why: a hypothesis worse than what runs is never adopted

properties.says: never when move is explore and dominance is dominated then recall
properties.why: a hypothesis worse than what runs is never adopted

properties.says: never when move is explore and dominance is incomparable then adopt
properties.why: a hypothesis that trades one objective for another is not adopted: improvement is strict Pareto dominance

properties.says: never when move is explore and dominance is incomparable then recall
properties.why: a hypothesis that trades one objective for another is not adopted: improvement is strict Pareto dominance

properties.says: never when move is reconcile and eased is no then adopt
properties.why: a reconciliation is adopted only when it eases the owner's dismissals

properties.says: never when move is reconcile and eased is no then recall
properties.why: a reconciliation is adopted only when it eases the owner's dismissals

properties.says: never when claim is known then adopt
properties.why: a claim is minted once: a known claim is recalled, never minted again

properties.says: never when claim is new then recall
properties.why: only a claim in the ledger can be recalled

properties.says: never when halted is no and tunable is yes and label is admit then refuse
properties.why: a well-formed, kappa-named candidate is weighed, never refused
